headline: Executive session to interview applicants for City Council Budget/Management Analyst position.
summary: The committee will meet in executive session to interview job applicants for the Budget/Management Analyst position. The Chair will then announce whether the open session will reconvene after the executive session.
items: Executive Session to consider or interview applicants for the City Council Budget/Management Analyst position, pursuant to Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 30A, Section 21(a)(8)
Announcement by the Chair on whether Open Session will reconvene following Executive Session
location: Fogg Room, Beverly Public Library, 32 Essex Street, Beverly, MA 01915
